name: anyNA
title: TRUE when any value is missing

origin.description: Look for NA or NaN, and optionally walk nested lists.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An atomic vector or a list.

origin.details: Without recursive, a list element that is itself a list is not missing. With recursive, nested lists are walked until an atomic NA or NaN is found.
origin.example:
bp_anyNA <- getFromNamespace("anyNA", "backports")
print(bp_anyNA(letters))
print(bp_anyNA(c(1, NA)))
print(bp_anyNA(list(list(1, NA), 2), recursive = TRUE))

translation.description: Look for NA or NaN, and optionally walk nested lists.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An atomic vector or a list.

translation.details: Without recursive, a list element that is itself a list is not missing. With recursive, nested lists are walked until an atomic NA or NaN is found.

print(anyNA([1, NA]))
print(anyNA([[1, NA], 2], recursive=True))
